title: Muthoot Pappachan Group
extract: Muthoot Pappachan Group, also known as Muthoot Blue, is an Indian financial service conglomerate founded in 1887 by Ninan Mathai Muthoot. Headquartered in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, the group has a workforce of more than 26,000 employees across 4,200 branches in India. Apart from financial services, the group has business interests in hospitality, automotive dealerships, real estate, healthcare, IT services, precious metals, alternate energy, and security services.
